title: Cornerstone Customer Activation Playbook and Feedback Synthesis
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Playbook to activate and steward a small set of high-value 'cornerstone' customers through beta → paid usage. Focuses on coordinated launch steps, release-notes alignment, structured feedback capture, and measurable success criteria to inform GA decisions.
goals: 1) Achieve first meaningful production calls from 6 cornerstone customers within 30 days of activation. 2) Capture high-fidelity qualitative and quantitative feedback that maps to product signals. 3) Produce a validated release-notes and go-to-market artifact set for GA launch.
scope: In scope: onboarding runbooks, release notes coordination, feedback synthesis rubric, operational SLAs for support handoff. Out of scope: pricing negotiations, deep custom engineering for individual customers (handled as follow-up scope).
success_metrics:
- 6 cornerstone accounts with >1k inference tokens/day or equivalent traffic within 30 days
- Customer Satisfaction survey mean >= 4.0 (5pt scale) at 14 days post-activation
- Feedback items triaged into product backlog with severity labels within 7 days
- No P0 reliability incidents attributable to platform changes during activation window
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding runbook exists and is validated by Solutions Engineering and Support
Release notes drafted, cross-reviewed, and published internally 7 days prior to each activation cohort
Telemetry dashboards (per-account latency, error-rate, token-cost) are configured and shared with customer success
Feedback template and rubric (qualitative + quantitative) are defined and approved by PM and Research

release_notes_plan: Customer-facing notes published to gated portal: 48 hours before activation
feedback_loop_design: Structured interview guide (10 questions) for product-researchers
Automated telemetry hooks: per-account 95th percentile latency, token cost per call, error-rate per 1k tokens
Feedback scoring rubric: Impact (1-5), Frequency (1-5), Effort to fix (1-5), Customer priority flag
Weekly synthesis artifact: top 10 signals with recommended action (triage labels: bug/regression/ux/product)
communication_plan: Pre-activation: email + calendar invite to customer + CSM + SE (72h before)
Activation day: Slack channel for live updates with Eng/SE/Support assigned
Post-activation: 7-day check-in (CSM + PM) and 14-day satisfaction survey
Executive summary: 21-day synthesis report to leadership and GTM
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Unexpected latency/regression in GA model. Mitigation: Fall back to pinned older model and enable read-only traffic routing until fix
Risk: Low signal from customers (sparse feedback). Mitigation: Provide incentives and schedule guided sessions with product researchers
Risk: Release-note misalignment causing customer confusion. Mitigation: Dry-run release notes internally, include a TL;DR section for engineers and a separate customer-facing section
